beats.say: Until twenty fifteen, bits of India sat inside Bangladesh, and bits of Bangladesh inside India.
A hundred and eleven Indian enclaves. Fifty-one Bangladeshi ones.
One was an enclave, in an enclave, in an enclave.
Dahala Khagrabari, the only one on Earth.
About fifty thousand people lived there, cut off from both countries.
At midnight in July twenty fifteen, the two countries swapped them all.
People could stay, or move across, and pick their citizenship.
In one night, a hundred and sixty-two little borders vanished.
The strangest map in Asia was finally fixed.
beats.cap: The strangest map in Asia, fixed
